_note: The models offered for Impulse 0.1.1 on first run and in Deploy your own. Only models verified with Impulse (its docs/RUN.md, docs/BUILD.md, docs/LFM25.md, docs/QWEN36.md). Edit here; the order is the order shown. needs: a NVIDIA card with at least gpu_mb of memory, ram_mb of system RAM (Impulse keeps the experts in RAM, a cache of them on the card), disk_mb free. friends: offered on a friend's path (joining by an invite); the owner sees every model. recommend: the order in which one model is recommended (the first that fits this computer).

models.name: LFM2.5 24B
models.about: Quick and light: answers fast on a 8 GB card. Text only.
models.verified: impulse/docs/LFM25.md (the official checkpoint; its hash in impulse/profiles/lfm25-qad-q4_0.json)

models.name: Gemma 4 26B
models.about: The all-rounder: thoughtful answers, reads pictures, fast with its drafter. Needs a 12 GB card.
models.verified: impulse/docs/BUILD.md and docs/RUN.md (the model, its MTP drafter and its projector)

standard.source: Google's own QAT Q4_0; the MTP head is gemma-4-26B-A4B-it's

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B
models.about: The biggest: strongest at code and long documents, reads pictures. Needs a 16 GB card and plenty of RAM.
models.verified: impulse/docs/BUILD.md and docs/QWEN36.md (the model and its projector; its MTP drafter is read out of another file with a tool, so it runs here without one)

standard.source: the official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, unsloth's Q4_K_M (impulse/docs/QWEN36.md: any qwen35moe GGUF)
standard.maker: Alibaba (unsloth's Q4_K_M of the official model)

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next
models.maker: Alibaba (Qwen), in the GGUF file you choose
models.about: The strongest here: 177B parameters, 3B at a time, for big jobs. You choose the file: paste a Hugging Face link and Nebula shows its sizes, checks it is Flash-Next and says whether it fits before anything downloads. Text only.
models.verified: impulse/CHANGELOG.md 0.2.4: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next (qwen4exp) in Impulse's Qwen engine, the same logits as llama.cpp b6b003d bit for bit; any qwen4exp GGUF (the experts stay in RAM, so its RAM need follows the file's size)

models.name: Flint 40B (Q4)
models.about: Built for coding: reads a codebase, fixes bugs, calls tools, thinks before it answers when it needs to. Text only. Q4: the smaller file. Runs on an 8 GB card and up with about 27 GB of free RAM for its experts; two cards that hold all of it write about twice as fast.

layouts.about: every expert on two cards that hold the whole model: about twice the writing speed of one card
the card with the most free memory: the expert cache on it, the experts in RAM

models.verified: impulse/docs/FLINT.md (unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL: top-1 96.6 % and KL 0.0085 against the BF16 weights on code; HumanEval)

uncensored.source: refusals removed with abliterix; Q4_K_M with a wikitext-2 imatrix

models.name: Flint 40B (Q6)
models.about: Flint at Q6: closest to the full model, the best choice for coding when the computer has the RAM. Runs on an 8 GB card and up with about 38 GB of free RAM for its experts.

the card with the most free memory: the expert cache on it, the experts in RAM
